title: Sources: NSA Net, the highly classified network that the NSA uses for its internal communications, is down; there is no evidence of a cyberattack (CNN)
summary: CNN: Sources: NSA Net, the highly classified network that the NSA uses for its internal communications, is down; there is no evidence of a cyberattack — The highly classified network that the National Security Agency uses for its internal communications is down, according to six people familiar with the matter.
